# Clean-Link

> Professional provider of HEPA and industrial air filtration solutions for commercial, healthcare, and cleanroom applications.

Clean-Link specializes in customized air filtration products including HEPA filters, HVAC systems, filter media, and specialized equipment for paint booths, cleanrooms, and industrial environments. The company offers both standard and cut-to-size filtration solutions with various MERV ratings and filter media compositions.

## Key Topics

- HEPA filters
- HVAC filtration
- Air filter media
- FFU (Fan Filter Unit)
- Paint booth filters
- Filter specifications (MERV ratings)
- Fiberglass filter media
- Industrial air filtration
- Cleanroom equipment
- Pocket/bag filters
- V-Bank filters
- Carbon filters
- Indoor air quality
- Overspray capture
- Customized filtration solutions
